settings.title: Who Am I?
settings.subtitle: Set up your game
settings.shareCodeMsg: Share this code with friends to play the exact same game:

mvp.name: MVP
mvp.description_locked: Gather ten chosen ones who have touched the Michael Jordan trophy, the supreme Grail of individual basketball.
mvp.description_unlocked: The MVP trophy rewards the best player of the year. You have found 10 of these legends.

dpoy.name: DPOY
dpoy.description: Find 10 Defensive Player of the Year winners
dpoy.description_locked: Gather ten impassable walls, experts in steals and masters of the clutch block.
dpoy.description_unlocked: The Hakeem Olajuwon trophy rewards the best defensive player of the year. You have found 10 of these legends.

splash_brothers.name: Splash Brothers
splash_brothers.description: Find both Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson
splash_brothers.description_locked: Two archers whose arrows always find the net. Together, they changed the way basketball is played.
splash_brothers.description_unlocked: Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson formed one of the most prolific duos in history, leading the Warriors to 4 NBA titles with unprecedented perimeter shooting.

cleveland_this_is_for_you.name: Cleveland, This is for you
cleveland_this_is_for_you.description: Find LeBron James, Kyrie Irving, and Kevin Love
cleveland_this_is_for_you.description_locked: Find the legendary trio that brought the title back to Ohio after being down 3-1 in the finals.
cleveland_this_is_for_you.description_unlocked: You found the heroes of the 2016 Cleveland Cavaliers, architects of the greatest comeback in NBA Finals history!

los_tres_amigos.name: Los Tres Amigos
los_tres_amigos.description: Find LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, and Chris Bosh
los_tres_amigos.description_locked: Find the iconic trio that took their talents to South Beach to rule the NBA.
los_tres_amigos.description_unlocked: You found the famous Miami Heat Big Three, back-to-back NBA champions in 2012 and 2013!

dream_team.name: Dream Team
dream_team.description: Find Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson, and Larry Bird
dream_team.description_locked: Find the three iconic faces of the team that dazzled the whole world at the 1992 Barcelona Games.
dream_team.description_unlocked: You found the three undisputed legends of the 1992 Dream Team: Jordan, Magic, and Bird!

11_vs_100.name: 11 vs 100
11_vs_100.description: Find Bill Russell and Wilt Chamberlain
11_vs_100.description_locked: Find the two greatest giants of the 60s: one collected 11 rings, the other scored 100 points in a single game.
11_vs_100.description_unlocked: You found Bill Russell and Wilt Chamberlain, the two legends who defined the first great era of NBA dominance!

lob_city.name: Lob City
lob_city.description: Find Chris Paul, Blake Griffin, and DeAndre Jordan
lob_city.description_locked: Find the spectacular Californian trio that turned Los Angeles into a dunk factory.
lob_city.description_unlocked: You found the founders of 'Lob City', the most exciting and high-flying era in Clippers history!

gregg_popovich.name: Gregg Popovich
gregg_popovich.description: Find Tim Duncan, Tony Parker, and Manu Ginóbili
gregg_popovich.description_locked: Find the legendary Spurs Big Three who dominated the league under Coach Pop's tutelage.
gregg_popovich.description_unlocked: You found the most victorious Big Three in history, symbol of the San Antonio Spurs and team basketball!

the_process.name: The Process
the_process.description: Find Joel Embiid and Ben Simmons
the_process.description_locked: Trust the rebuild and find the polarizing Philadelphia 76ers duo.
the_process.description_unlocked: Ah, 'Trust the Process'! You found Joel Embiid and Ben Simmons, one of the most polarizing duos in modern NBA history.

eleven_rings.name: Eleven Rings
eleven_rings.description: Find Phil Jackson, Michael Jordan, and Kobe Bryant
eleven_rings.description_locked: Find the mythical coach with 11 rings and his two greatest students.
eleven_rings.description_unlocked: You found Phil Jackson, MJ, and Kobe: the faces of triangle offense excellence!

the_last_dance.name: The Last Dance
the_last_dance.description: Find Phil Jackson, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, and Dennis Rodman
the_last_dance.description_locked: Find the coach and the three core players of the legendary Bulls three-peat (1996-1998).
the_last_dance.description_unlocked: It's a wrap! You reunited the full cast of 'The Last Dance'.

the_original_big_3.name: The Original Big 3
the_original_big_3.description: Find Larry Bird, Kevin McHale, and Robert Parish
the_original_big_3.description_locked: Find the formidable Celtics trio that dominated the East in the 80s.
the_original_big_3.description_unlocked: Incredible! You found Bird, McHale, and Parish, the original Big 3 of the Boston Celtics!

bad_boys.name: Bad Boys
bad_boys.description: Find Dennis Rodman, Joe Dumars, and Isiah Thomas
bad_boys.description_locked: Find the three figureheads of the roughest and most feared team of the 80s.
bad_boys.description_unlocked: Watch out for those elbows! You found the infamous Detroit Bad Boys.

showtime.name: Showtime
showtime.description: Find Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Magic Johnson, Michael Cooper, and Pat Riley
showtime.description_locked: Find the architects of the most spectacular Lakers dynasty of the 80s.
showtime.description_unlocked: Glitter, stars, and total basketball! You brought Lakers Showtime back to life.

grit_and_grind.name: Grit and Grind
grit_and_grind.description: Find Marc Gasol, Mike Conley, and Zach Randolph
grit_and_grind.description_locked: Find the pillars of the tough and hard-working Memphis team of the 2010s.
grit_and_grind.description_unlocked: Take cover! You found the kings of the Memphis 'Grit and Grind'.

seven_seconds_or_less.name: 7 Seconds or Less
seven_seconds_or_less.description: Find Steve Nash, Amar'e Stoudemire, and Shawn Marion
seven_seconds_or_less.description_locked: Find the Phoenix rockets that revolutionized offensive play in the 2000s.
seven_seconds_or_less.description_unlocked: Pedal to the metal! You found the masters of '7 Seconds or Less'.

open_mic.name: Open Mic
open_mic.description: Find Charles Barkley, Shaquille O'Neal, and Reggie Miller
open_mic.description_locked: Find three hardwood legends who became the most unmissable (and loudest) voices on American television.
open_mic.description_unlocked: On air! You found the three basketball players who became the most iconic TV analysts.

clipboard_masterminds.name: Clipboard Masterminds
clipboard_masterminds.description: Find Rick Carlisle, Steve Kerr, and Phil Jackson
clipboard_masterminds.description_locked: Find these three former role players who evolved into some of the most brilliant and decorated head coaches in history.
clipboard_masterminds.description_unlocked: From the end of the bench to the top of the league! You found the ultimate clipboard masterminds.

we_the_north.name: We The North
we_the_north.description: Find Kawhi Leonard, Marc Gasol, and Kyle Lowry
we_the_north.description_locked: Find the main architects of the Canadian franchise's first and only NBA title.
we_the_north.description_unlocked: Oh Canada! You found the heroes of Toronto's championship run.

eternal_rivals.name: Eternal Rivals
eternal_rivals.description: Find both Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo
eternal_rivals.description_locked: Two kings who shared a throne for over a decade. Their rivalry defined an era.
eternal_rivals.description_unlocked: Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo dominated world football for over 15 years, sharing 13 Ballons d'Or and breaking every scoring record.

golden_balls.name: Golden Balls
golden_balls.description_locked: Gather ten chosen ones who have touched the golden sphere, the ultimate Holy Grail of individual football.
golden_balls.description_unlocked: The Ballon d'Or rewards the best football player of the year. You have found 10 of these legends.

sang_et_or.name: Blood and Gold
sang_et_or.description: Find Guillaume Warmuz, Jean-Guy Wallemme, and Anto Drobnjak
sang_et_or.description_locked: Three warriors of an unexpected spring in the North, where blood and gold triumphed.
sang_et_or.description_unlocked: You found three legends from the 1998 RC Lens championship team: Warmuz, Wallemme, and Drobnjak.

periple_rouge.name: The Red Journey
periple_rouge.description: Find Fernando Morientes, Ludovic Giuly, Dado Pršo, and Patrice Evra
periple_rouge.description_locked: Four companions of a princely odyssey that dazzled Europe all the way to the gates of ultimate glory.
periple_rouge.description_unlocked: AS Monaco reached the Champions League final in 2004. You found Morientes, Giuly, Pršo, and Evra.

gones.name: Gones
gones.description: Find at least 3 players among Cris, Juninho, Lisandro López, Coupet, and Govou
gones.description_locked: Find three builders of a dynasty that reigned seven consecutive times over French football.
gones.description_unlocked: You found three legends from the great years of Olympique Lyonnais.

miracle_istanbul.name: The Miracle of Istanbul
miracle_istanbul.description: Find Steven Gerrard, Vladimír Šmicer, and Xabi Alonso
miracle_istanbul.description_locked: Three goals in six minutes to overturn the impossible. Find the authors of this resurrection.
miracle_istanbul.description_unlocked: You found the three heroes of Liverpool FC's crazy comeback against AC Milan in 2005.

a_jamais_les_premiers.name: Forever the First
a_jamais_les_premiers.description: Find at least 3 players from the 1993 Olympique de Marseille
a_jamais_les_premiers.description_locked: Find three pioneers of a port city club that was the first to plant its flag at the summit of Europe.
a_jamais_les_premiers.description_unlocked: You found three legends of Olympique de Marseille, the first French club to win the Champions League.

fergie_time.name: Fergie Time
fergie_time.description: Find Ole Gunnar Solskjær and Teddy Sheringham
fergie_time.description_locked: Two ghosts emerged in the dying seconds to turn certain defeat into eternal triumph.
fergie_time.description_unlocked: You found Solskjær and Sheringham, the two goalscorers who turned around the 1999 Champions League final in stoppage time.

galactiques.name: The Galácticos
galactiques.description: Find Zinedine Zidane, David Beckham, Ronaldo, and Luís Figo
galactiques.description_locked: Four stars assembled in the Spanish capital, a cast from another world.
galactiques.description_unlocked: You found Zidane, Beckham, Ronaldo, and Figo, the poster boys of Real Madrid's Galácticos era.

mourir_tranquille.name: On peut mourir tranquille
mourir_tranquille.description: Find Barthez, Blanc, Zidane, Deschamps, and Djorkaeff
mourir_tranquille.description_locked: Five heroes of a July night when an entire country roared as one on the Champs-Élysées.
mourir_tranquille.description_unlocked: You found 5 of the greatest heroes of the 1998 World Cup winning French national team.

seconde_etoile.name: The Second Star
seconde_etoile.description: Find Mbappé, Griezmann, Kanté, Lloris, and Varane
seconde_etoile.description_locked: Five architects of a Moscow summer when a second star came to light up the blue jersey.
seconde_etoile.description_unlocked: You found 5 heroes of France's triumphant 2018 World Cup campaign in Russia.

amunt_valencia.name: Amunt Valencia
amunt_valencia.description: Find Gaizka Mendieta, Santiago Cañizares, and Claudio López
amunt_valencia.description_locked: Three heirs of a bat that soared all the way to two of Europe's greatest finals.
amunt_valencia.description_unlocked: You found Mendieta, Cañizares, and Piojo López, three legends who took Valencia CF to the top of Europe.

hala_madrid.name: Hala Madrid
hala_madrid.description: Find 5 players among Butragueño, Ramos, Casillas, Raúl, Di Stéfano, Zidane, C. Ronaldo, and Modrić
hala_madrid.description_locked: Five legends of a white kingdom that has been collecting European crowns for decades.
hala_madrid.description_unlocked: You found 5 absolute legends who have written the history and fame of Real Madrid.

visca_barca.name: Visca Barça
visca_barca.description: Find 5 players among Guardiola, Eto'o, Puyol, Xavi, Iniesta, Messi, Rivaldo, Ronaldinho, and Cruyff
visca_barca.description_locked: Five legends of a club that calls itself much more than a club, cathedral of the Catalan style of play.
visca_barca.description_unlocked: Més que un club! You found 5 legends who brought glory and pride to Barça.

9_juillet.name: July 9th
9_juillet.description: Find Zinedine Zidane and Marco Materazzi
9_juillet.description_locked: Two men, a gesture of rage, and the most bitter farewell in football history. A summer night in Berlin.
9_juillet.description_unlocked: An unforgettable headbutt! You brought Zidane and Materazzi together.

main_de_dieu.name: Hand of God
main_de_dieu.description: Find Peter Shilton and Diego Maradona
main_de_dieu.description_locked: A deceived goalkeeper and an Argentine genius. The hand of the divine and the goal of the century, born in the same match.
main_de_dieu.description_unlocked: A little with the head of Maradona and a little with the hand of God. You brought Shilton and Maradona together!

scapulaire.name: Scapulaire
scapulaire.description_locked: Three architects of a coronation by the Garonne, when the wind of Aquitaine swept through the championship.
scapulaire.description_unlocked: Navy and White! You brought together the heroes of Bordeaux's 2009 title.

siempre_con_nosotros.name: Siempre con nosotros
siempre_con_nosotros.description_locked: Three champions whose triumph carries the memory of a friend gone too soon. A jersey lifted, an eternal message.
siempre_con_nosotros.description_unlocked: Dani Jarque siempre con nosotros. An eternal tribute by Andrés Iniesta during the 2010 final.

class_of_92.name: Class of '92
class_of_92.description_locked: Find three diamonds cut from the same cradle, forged by a Scottish sorcerer with a fiery temper.
class_of_92.description_unlocked: The golden generation! You found Beckham, Giggs, and Scholes, pillars of the Class of '92.

aranycsapat.name: Aranycsapat
aranycsapat.description_locked: Three phantoms of an invincible team from the Puszta, who humiliated the inventors of football.
aranycsapat.description_unlocked: The Golden Team! You found Hidegkuti, Grosics, and Puskás, pillars of the Hungarian Aranycsapat.

dogues.name: Dogues
dogues.description: Find Eden Hazard, Gervinho, and Moussa Sow
dogues.description_locked: Three players from a historic double in the North, when the mastiffs bit their way to the crown.
dogues.description_unlocked: You found three key architects of LOSC's 2011 French championship title.

football_total.name: Total Football
football_total.description: Find Johan Cruyff and Johan Neeskens
football_total.description_locked: Two Dutch visionaries who invented a brand of football where every player could do everything on the pitch.
football_total.description_unlocked: You found Cruyff and Neeskens, the two inseparable geniuses of Total Football.

carre_magique.name: Magic Square
carre_magique.description: Find Platini, Giresse, Tigana, and Fernandez
carre_magique.description_locked: Four magicians at the heart of the game, whose alchemy drew a perfect square in French football.
carre_magique.description_unlocked: You have reunited the legendary Magic Square of the French national team, winners of the 1984 Euro.
